reasons.plausibility: Adding small amounts of W to a BCC HEA to improve high-temperature strength aligns with known solid-solution strengthening mechanisms and prior studies, though there is some uncertainty regarding its impact on ductility.
reasons.testability: The proposed incremental doping and mechanical testing at 1273 K provide a clear, feasible way to confirm or refute the hypothesized strength and ductility benefits.
reasons.usefulness: This focused intervention directly addresses the known high-temperature limitations of TiVNbTa as an intermediate layer for W–CuCrZr interfaces, making it highly relevant for divertor component design.
